sql: SELECT T1.Maker, T2.Year FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 INNER JOIN CARS_DATA AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.MakeId WHERE T2.Year  =  '1970'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Name FROM singer AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID  =  T2.Singer_ID WHERE T2.Sales  >  300000
SELECT T1.Name ,  sum(T2.Sales) FROM singer AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID  =  T2.Singer_ID GROUP BY T1.Name
SELECT MIN(Weight) FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders = 8 AND Year = 1974
SELECT MAX(Accelerate) ,  Cylinders FROM CARS_DATA GROUP BY Cylinders

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM CARS_DATA 
WHERE horsepower > 150 
AND horsepower IN (SELECT MAX(horsepower) FROM CARS_DATA)
SELECT AVG(mpg) FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders = 4 OR Year < 1980

SELECT AVG(mpg) 
FROM CARS_DATA 
WHERE Cylinders = 4 OR Year < 1980

SELECT DISTINCT T2.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Model  =  T2.Model JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T2.Maker  =  T3.Id JOIN CARS_DATA AS T4 ON T1.MakeId  =  T4.Id WHERE T3.FullName  =  'Ford Motor Company' AND T4.weight  <  3500
SELECT FullName FROM car_makers WHERE Country = '1'

SELECT t1.id, t1.maker
FROM car_makers t1
JOIN model_list t2 ON t1.id = t2.maker
JOIN car_names t3 ON t2.model = t3.model
WHERE t3.model = 'fiat'
OR t1.maker IN (SELECT Id FROM car_makers WHERE Country = '1' OR Country = '2')
SELECT name ,  capacity FROM stadium ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Abbreviation FROM AIRLINES WHERE Airline = 'JetBlue Airways'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airlines
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights AS T1 JOIN airlines AS T2 ON T2.uid  =  T1.Airline WHERE T2.Airline  =  "United Airlines"
SELECT AirportName FROM AIRPORTS WHERE City  =  "Aberdeen"
SELECT COUNT(T1.FlightNo) FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRPORTS AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport   =  T2.AirportCode WHERE T2.City  =  "Aberdeen"
SELECT COUNT(T1.FlightNo) FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRPORTS AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport   =  T2.AirportCode WHERE T2.City  =  "Aberdeen"

SELECT count(*) FROM flights AS T1 JOIN airports AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport  =  T2.AirportCode JOIN airports AS T3 ON T1.SourceAirport  =  T3.AirportCode WHERE T2.City  =  "Ashley" AND T3.City  =  "Aberdeen"
SELECT COUNT(T1.Airline) FROM AIRLINES AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.uid  =  T2.Airline WHERE T2.SourceAirport  =  "AHD" AND T1.Airline = 'United Airlines'
SELECT T1.Abbreviation ,  T1.Country FROM AIRLINES AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.uid  =  T2.Airline GROUP BY T1.Airline ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRLINES AS T2 ON T1.Airline  =  T2.uid WHERE T2.Airline = "JetBlue Airways" OR T1.FlightNo < 200

SELECT T2.Airline
FROM FLIGHTS AS T1
JOIN AIRLINES AS T2 ON T1.Airline = T2.uid
WHERE T1.FlightNo < 200
SELECT T2.name ,  COUNT(*) FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.Year > '2013' GROUP BY T1.stadium_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.FlightNo) FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRPORTS AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport   =  T2.AirportCode WHERE T2.City  =  "Aberdeen" OR T2.City  =  "Abilene"

SELECT Location, COUNT(*) as Number_of_shops 
FROM shop 
GROUP BY Location 
ORDER BY Number_of_shops DESC

SELECT name ,  LOCATION ,  district 
FROM shop 
ORDER BY number_products DESC
SELECT T1.name FROM stadium AS T1 JOIN concert AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id GROUP BY T1.stadium_id

SELECT t2.name, COUNT(*) as num_employees
FROM hiring AS t1 JOIN shop AS t2 ON t1.shop_id  =  t2.shop_id
GROUP BY t2.name
ORDER BY num_employees DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(t2.bonus) FROM evaluation AS t1 JOIN evaluation AS t2 ON t1.Employee_ID  =  t2.Employee_ID ORDER BY t2.bonus DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Template_ID FROM Templates EXCEPT SELECT Template_ID FROM Documents
SELECT DISTINCT template_type_code ,  template_type_description FROM Ref_template_types

SELECT T1.Name , T1.Theme , T1.Year , T2.Name AS Singer_Name , COUNT(*) AS Number_of_Singers 
FROM concert AS T1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.concert_ID = T2.concert_ID 
GROUP BY T1.Name , T1.Theme , T1.Year , T2.Name 
ORDER BY T1.Name
SELECT T1.paragraph_text FROM Paragraphs AS T1 JOIN Documents AS T2 ON T1.document_id  =  T2.document_id WHERE T2.document_name  =  "Customer reviews" AND T1.paragraph_text LIKE '%Korea %'
SELECT Age ,  Hometown FROM teacher
SELECT Name FROM teacher WHERE Age = '32' OR Age = '33'
SELECT T2.Name FROM course_arrange AS T1 JOIN teacher AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID  =  T2.Teacher_ID GROUP BY T2.Name HAVING COUNT(*)  >=  2
SELECT T1.Name ,  T2.Course FROM teacher AS T1 JOIN course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID  =  T2.Teacher_ID WHERE T2.Grade IS NULL
SELECT T1.first_name, T1.birth_date FROM players AS T1 JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.loser_id WHERE T2.loser_ioc  =  'USA'
SELECT AVG(loser_age) ,  AVG(winner_age) FROM matches
SELECT AVG(winner_rank) FROM matches
SELECT MIN(loser_rank) FROM matches

SELECT T1.tourney_name 
FROM tourney AS T1 
JOIN tourney_matches AS T2 ON T1.tourney_id  =  T2.tourney_id 
JOIN players AS T3 ON T2.loser_id  =  T3.player_id 
WHERE T2.match_num  >  10

SELECT 
  AVG(ranking_points) , 
  T1.first_name 
FROM 
  players AS T1 
  JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id 
GROUP BY 
  T1.first_name
SELECT country_code FROM players GROUP BY country_code ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT first_name, country_code, birth_date 
FROM players 
WHERE player_id IN (
  SELECT winner_id 
  FROM matches 
  WHERE tourney_name  =  'Australian Open'
)
ORDER BY winner_rank DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT name, result, bulgarian_commander
FROM battle
WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT lost_in_battle FROM ship WHERE tonnage = '225')

SELECT DISTINCT 
  `line_1`, 
  `line_2`, 
  `line_3`, 
  `city`, 
  `zip_postcode`, 
  `state_province_county`, 
  `country`, 
  `other_address_details`
FROM 
  Addresses
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Courses
SELECT T2.course_description FROM course AS T1 INNER JOIN course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Course_ID  =  T2.Course_ID WHERE T1.Course  =  "Math"
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Student AS T1 JOIN Has_Pet AS T2 ON T1.stuid  =  T2.stuid WHERE T1.age > 20
SELECT section_name FROM Sections ORDER BY section_name DESC

SELECT DISTINCT T1.semester_name
FROM Degree_Programs AS T1
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id
WHERE T2.student_id IS NULL

SELECT T1.semester_name
FROM Semesters AS T1
WHERE T1.semester_id NOT IN (
  SELECT T2.semester_id
  FROM Degree_Programs AS T2
  JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T3 ON T2.degree_program_id  =  T3.degree_program_id
  WHERE T2.degree_summary_name  =  'Master'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT T2.semester_id
  FROM Degree_Programs AS T2
  JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T3 ON T2.degree_program_id  =  T3.degree_program_id
  WHERE T2.degree_summary_name  =  'Bachelor'
)
SELECT T2.transcript_date ,  T1.transcript_id FROM Transcript_Contents AS T1 JOIN Transcripts AS T2 ON T1.transcript_id  =  T2.transcript_id GROUP BY T1.transcript_id HAVING count(*) >= 2

SELECT cell_mobile_number 
FROM Students 
WHERE first_name = 'Timmothy' AND last_name = 'Ward'

SELECT DISTINCT T2.semester_id
FROM Degree_Programs AS T1
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id
WHERE T1.degree_summary_name  =  'Master'
INTERSECT
SELECT DISTINCT T2.semester_id
FROM Degree_Programs AS T1
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id
WHERE T1.degree_summary_name  =  'Bachelor'
SELECT Title FROM Cartoon ORDER BY title
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Fname FROM student AS T1 JOIN has_pet AS T2 ON T1.stuid  =  T2.stuid JOIN pets AS T3 ON T3.petid  =  T2.petid WHERE T3.pettype  =  'cat' AND T3.pettype  =  'dog'
SELECT T1.series_name FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN Cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T2.Title = "The Rise of the Blue Beetle!"
SELECT T2.Title FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN Cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T1.series_name = "Sky Radio"
SELECT T1.`Weekly_Rank` FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN TV_series AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T2.Episode = "A Love of a Lifetime"

SELECT T1.package_option, T1.series_name 
FROM TV_Channel AS T1 
JOIN TV_series AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel 
WHERE T2.Episode = "A Love of a Lifetime"
SELECT T1.Package_Option FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN Cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T2.directed_by  =  'Ben Jones'
SELECT MAX(Final_Table_Made) ,  Best_Finish FROM poker_player WHERE Earnings < 200000
SELECT T1.Name FROM people AS T1 JOIN poker_player AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID
SELECT People_ID ,  People.Name FROM poker_player ORDER BY Final_Table_Made ASC
SELECT Money_Rank FROM poker_player ORDER BY Earnings DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(Earnings) FROM poker_player WHERE Height > 200

SELECT DISTINCT state ,  created ,  phone_number 
FROM votes 
WHERE contestant_number =  'Tabatha Gehling'
SELECT T1.contestant_name FROM contestants AS T1 JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number  =  T2.contestant_number WHERE T1.contestant_name LIKE '%Al%'
SELECT T1.Continent FROM country AS T1 INNER JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language = 'English'
SELECT T1.Continent FROM country AS T1 INNER JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language = 'English' AND T1.Name = 'Anguilla'

SELECT avg(GNP) ,  sum(population) 
FROM country 
WHERE GovernmentForm  =  "US Territory" 
AND Continent  =  "Asia"
SELECT Population FROM city WHERE District = 'Gelderland'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Continent) FROM country
SELECT T1.Name ,  T1.Population FROM city AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" ORDER BY T1.Population DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT T1.PetID FROM Student AS T1 JOIN Has_Pet AS T2 ON T1.stuid  =  T2.stuid WHERE T1.LName = 'Smith'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Continent = 'Europe' THEN T1.Population ELSE 0 END) , 
       AVG(T1.SurfaceArea) 
FROM country AS T1 INNER JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode 
WHERE T1.Continent = 'North America' AND T1.SurfaceArea > 3000

SELECT 
  c.Name , 
  c.Code2 , 
  c.Capital , 
  c.HeadOfState 
FROM 
  country c 
JOIN 
  countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode 
WHERE 
  cl.Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM countrylanguage)

SELECT 
  c.Name, 
  c.LifeExpectancy, 
  SUM(c.Population) AS TotalPopulation
FROM 
  country c
WHERE 
  c.LifeExpectancy < 72
GROUP BY 
  c.Name, 
  c.LifeExpectancy
SELECT Name ,  SurfaceArea FROM country ORDER BY SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT Name FROM conductor ORDER BY Year_of_Work DESC

SELECT T1.Official_ratings_(millions) AS Max_Official_Ratings, T1.Official_ratings_(millions) AS Min_Official_Ratings
FROM performance T1
WHERE T1.Type = 'Auditions 1' OR T1.Type = 'Auditions 2'
AND T1.`Official_ratings_(millions)` IS NOT NULL
AND T1.Type != 'Live final'
SELECT T1.Name ,  T2.Orchestra FROM conductor AS T1 JOIN orchestra AS T2 ON T1.Conductor_ID  =  T2.Conductor_ID GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(T2.Orchestra)  >  1
SELECT ID FROM Highschooler WHERE name  =  "Kyle"
SELECT count(*) FROM Highschooler WHERE grade IN (9, 10)
SELECT COUNT(T1.friend_id) FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id JOIN Highschooler AS T3 ON T1.friend_id  =  T3.id WHERE T2.name  =  "Kyle"
SELECT T1.student_id FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id
SELECT name ,  count(*) FROM Highschooler GROUP BY name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.name FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id WHERE T1.liked_id  =  T2.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTINENTS

SELECT T1.first_name ,  T2.name 
FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id 
WHERE T1.first_name NOT IN (SELECT first_name FROM Owners) OR T1.first_name NOT IN (SELECT first_name FROM Dogs)

SELECT T1.role_code ,  T1.street ,  T1.city ,  T1.state 
FROM Professionals AS T1 
JOIN Owners AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.owner_id 
JOIN Cities AS T3 ON T2.city  =  T3.city 
WHERE T3.city LIKE '%West%'

SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name ,  T1.email_address 
FROM Owners AS T1 
JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id 
WHERE T1.state LIKE '%North%'
SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name ,  T1.email_address FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id WHERE T1.state LIKE '%North%'
SELECT cost_of_treatment FROM Treatments ORDER BY date_of_treatment DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T1.first_name) 
FROM Owners AS T1 
LEFT JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id 
WHERE T2.dog_id IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name ,  T1.first_name AS "Professional's First Name", 
                 T2.treatment_type_description FROM professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.professional_id
